summary: Chat 5 completed CANDIDATE_CORPUS_CERTIFICATION_PARALLEL for Atlasfin reference interoperability. A certified derivative was created from current main 8cc1918c5e015d1408335c15313e7364e04859c2 under prisma-html/extras/atlasfin/bridge/certification/**. Exact raw worker heads for Tablet, PC, Mobile and Shared UI were read directly; 2,097 source outcome records yielded 2,421 non-null Atlasfin references. All 2,421 normalized refs validate against current structured Atlasfin authority, hardInvalidRefCount=0, semanticMutationCount=0, and 341 representation-only adapter normalizations were recorded with original value and source-record SHA-256 provenance.
findings: Raw source accounting revalidated exactly: Tablet 929, PC 827, Mobile 271, Shared UI 70, aggregate 2,097.
Every one of the 2,097 surface outcomes carries an Atlasfin adapter reference; 324 records also carry a non-null Atlasfin recipe reference.
2,421/2,421 non-null Atlasfin references certify as VALID_REFERENCE against current structured authority; INVALID_REFS.jsonl is empty.

341 representation-only normalizations are required: Mobile 271 and Shared UI 70 qualified atlasfin:: adapter values normalize to raw Atlasfin IDs inside atlasfin.* strict candidate fields while preserving original serialized values and source-record hashes.

Re-derived recipe convergence: REC.table.governed.v2 = Tablet 66 + PC 105; REC.card.governed.v2 = Tablet 41 + PC 54; REC.panel.governed.v2 = Tablet 20 + PC 27; REC.overlay.governed.v2 = Tablet 11 only.
Recipe equality is explicitly certified as review-only and semanticCoalescingAllowed=false. It does not prove shared NDC/Identity meaning.
decisions: Use raw Atlasfin IDs inside atlasfin.* candidate fields; strip only an atlasfin:: prefix when present and preserve the original value in certification provenance.
Keep authority-qualified evidence references qualified; the normalization policy applies only to Atlasfin field serialization.
Exclude all-null and NO_MATCH records from semantic recipe coalescing review.
Preserve Atlasfin, Identity/RIFAT and NDC authority-domain separation.
Do not open a certification PR, do not merge PR #540, do not update prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json, and do not perform canonical/product/runtime mutation.
